newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Strauss-Kahn promises new policy direction.
newsitem.headline: France's Strauss-Kahn promises new policy direction.

text.p: New Socialist Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn took over an expanded super ministry of economy, finance and industry from outgoing centrist Jean Arthuis on Thursday promising a new direction in policy.
In an unusually brief handover ceremony, he gave no details on the policies of the new Socialist-led government, swept to power by a parliamentary election last Sunday.
"French people wanted a new direction in policies," he said.
He said some of the policies pursued by his predecessors, were partly going in the right direction but obviously some policy shifts will emerge.
He also said he had been keen to focus French policies in a new super finance ministry.
"I wanted the unity of the economy and finance ministry to be maintained and even reinforced," he said.

Strauss-Kahn was named on Wednesday to a ministry grouping economy, finance, industry and energy, with junior ministers and secretaries of state for budget, trade, small business and communications reporting directly to him.
"The structure of this ministry resolves this concern for efficiency," he said about the new structure.
